title: Pat-a-cake with a partner is listed at 1 year
summary: Most children play games with a caregiver, such as pat-a-cake, by about 1 year, CDC says.
body: The only social milestone CDC prints for the first birthday is playing games with you, like pat-a-cake. That is a partner game with a shared rhythm. Most means 75 percent or more on this page, not every baby and not a requirement to know one song. The materials are not a screening test. Clapping from excitement shows up later on the 15-month list and is a separate item.
